capabilities: Create note files for unresolved wikilinks when the cursor leaves a line
Create missing parent folders for new files
Shorten links to the shortest unique path after creation
Preserve headings and aliases when shortening links
Restrict auto-creation to configured watched folders
disambiguation: Not a link checker or link rewriter; it only creates missing note files for unresolved wikilinks.
extras: Releases include GitHub Artifact Attestations (Sigstore) so builds can be verified against the repo source; the author notes the Obsidian plugin ecosystem lacks build verification.
problem: Obsidian leaves unresolved wikilinks as dead links until you manually create the target file, interrupting writing flow.

summary: Auto-creates note files from unresolved wikilinks when you leave a line, creating missing folders and optionally shortening the link.
